Container.Name: homa
Container.Overview:
Homa is a self-hosted calendar and task app. It keeps your own calendars and syncs with CalDAV, Google and Microsoft calendars, with reminders, tasks and projects, natural-language quick add, and the Jalali calendar alongside the Gregorian one. English and Farsi.
Needs Postgres 16 or newer: install a Postgres container first and create a database and user for Homa, then fill in DATABASE_URL. On first start, the 4-digit setup code for the admin account is in this container's log ("first-run setup code").
Container.Requires: A Postgres 16 or newer container (for example the official postgres image) with a database and user for Homa.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port Homa's web app and API listen on.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Postgres connection string, such as postgres://homa:PASSWORD@[IP]:5432/homa

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Signs sessions. At least 32 random characters: openssl rand -base64 32. Don't change it later, or everyone is signed out.

Config.Name: HOMA_URL
Config.Description: The address you open Homa at (your server's IP or domain). Sign-ins from any other address are refused.

Config.Name: HOMA_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Encrypts connected calendars' credentials. Needed once you connect a calendar: openssl rand -base64 32. Keep it with your backups.

Config.Name: HOMA_ROLE
Config.Description: all runs the web app and background jobs in this one container.
